note: The description allows three attempts in total; the loop makes four (`<= 3`). Labelled by what the app acts on, a comment asking for a change on the loop line, and by a claim about the bound: a clause that states the extra attempt or a tighter bound, with no negation in that clause.

pr.title: Retry failed uploads
pr.body: Retries a failed upload, making at most three attempts in total, so a flaky network no longer drops files.

comments.body: Should this cap retries? A busy server would get hammered.

conversation.body: Added the retry loop; ready for another look.
